title: Pizzira
summary: A mobile pizza truck built on a vintage Volkswagen van. The pizza-slice roof lifts open to reveal a compact kitchen.
summary_ar: عربة بيتزا متنقلة مبنية على ميكروباص فولكس فاجن كلاسيكي. يرتفع سقف على شكل شريحة بيتزا ليكشف مطبخًا صغيرًا متكاملًا.

sections.heading: The idea
sections.body: Pizzira turns the classic food truck into a moving pizza experience. The design focuses on compact efficiency, modular transformation and eye-catching looks, bringing fresh pizza and fun to city streets and events.

sections.heading: Transformation
sections.body: The pizza roof opens upward to make room for the kitchen and serving counter, while the side view keeps the iconic pizza-slice branding and a compact service layout.
